title: Hierarchical low-rank compression exploiting symmetric boundary integral equations in transmission scattering
summary: We propose an approach using matrix symmetry to accelerate hierarchical low-rank compression for wave transmission scattering. For Helmholtz transmission problems, we introduce a symmetric Müller-like boundary integral equation formulation. Although not of the second kind, this formulation creates no difficulties for direct solvers. A one-point corrected quadrature in a Nyström discretization preserves the complex symmetry of the discretized system.
